releaseNotes:
• Tier 0 Ultra-Fast Resolution (<400ms): Native OkHttp GraphQL web resolver with HTTP/2 + TLS 1.3 socket pre-warming
• Zero-Allocation Streaming Pipeline: Direct off-heap NIO direct buffers to MediaStore FileChannel for smooth 4K downloads
• Android 16 (API 36) Hardened: Predictive Back gestures, SpecialUse FGS compliance, and Accessibility binder watchdog
• Spring-Damper Physics: Velocity-aware floating overlay docking
• Shared Element Transitions: Seamless photo zoom animations between Gallery and Media Viewer
• Seamless In-App OTA Update: Direct native PackageInstaller without external browser redirects
